news.full_en:
Hello, Adventurers!  Welcome to “This Month in Sky”, where we share Sky news, community activities, and creations from Sky Kids around the world. It’s been one year since we started This Month in Sky, and we have plenty of fun news to celebrate!  This month, not only are we looking forward to Season of Pearl and Days of Mischief with all of its tricks and treats, but the Community and Events teams worked together to come up with an extra treat this year: a Community Goal activity! Read on for details and other surprises! 

 Please note: All dates and times are listed in PST/PDT. 

 Sky News Update 35.0 October 13th Update 35.0 is on its way! Later this month, keep an eye out for the patch notes and update video to get the full details on new additions and bug fixes.  
 Season of Pearl October 16th - December 31st The final Sky season of 2026 is almost here, and brings with it a new tale to explore! Beginning on October 16th, meet the Old Angler, hear their story, and take part in their adventure on the seas.  
 Days of Mischief October 23rd - November 12th Get ready for tricks, treats, and mischievous fun in the Cackling Crab. There’s a lot to explore – meet the tiny witch Brigitta and other characters who only visit this time of year, play new games like Dark Dragons vs. Crabs, and enjoy returning favorites like the Broom Races. Back by popular demand, the krill have returned to the TGC Office rooftop and are ready to hand out “hugs”, launching Sky Kids into the air! There might even be an extra treat in store; see our Community Announcements section for details on a special Days of Mischief Community Goal activity!

 Radiance Event October 2nd - 15th Black and red Colored Light will appear more often, and there’s increased inventory in the Dye Exchange Shop.  
 Traveling Spirits October 8th - 11th, Welcome back the Traveling Spirit you voted for in the 2026 Sky Creator Awards! October 22nd - 25th 

 Community Announcements Days of Mischief Community Goal: Hug the Office Rooftop Krill October 23rd - November 6th It’s time for Sky’s first in-game Community Goal activity! Beginning with Days of Mischief on October 23rd, if Sky Kids collectively receive 250,000 “hugs” (tackles) from the krill flying above the TGC Office rooftop by November 6th, everyone will receive a special memento in their inbox. Don’t worry, though – these particular mischievous krill may send you flying, but it’s all in the spirit of fun! They won’t try to steal your Winged Light when you visit. Keep an eye out on our social media channels and in-game inbox for more details later this month! 
 Aviary Interview Stage Schedule Join Tethys on the Interview Stage! Please note the schedule change from 4pm to 5:30pm Pacific, starting on October 27th. 
 Note: thatgamecompany is in a region affected by Daylight Saving Time, which means the Sky schedule changes from PDT to PST on November 1st. Please double check a time conversion website if you’re worried about missing an event! 
 October 1st, 4pm PDT (UTC -7) October 6th, 4pm PDT (UTC -7) October 8th, 4pm PDT (UTC -7) October 27th, 5:30pm PDT (UTC -7) October 29th, 5:30pm PDT (UTC -7) November 3rd, 5:30pm PST (UTC -8) November 5th, 5:30pm PST (UTC -8) 
 Community Eden Run October 30th, 5pm PDT (UTC -7) Dress up in your favorite Mischief costume and join Tethys and other TGC staff members, along with a whole host of Sky Kids, during this costumed Community Eden Run! Festival Tech will be enabled during this event, so it’s the perfect time to head through the Eden gates with friends.

news.full_en:
Hello, Adventurers!  Welcome to “This Month in Sky”, where we share Sky news, community activities, and creations from Sky Kids around the world.  This month, we have the final days of Dear Van Gogh as well as the beginning of Days of Moonlight. Sky Kids can also look forward to some extra candle opportunities and the next round of community events!
 Please note: All dates and times are listed in PST/PDT. Sky News Dear Van Gogh While the story of Dear Van Gogh will stay in our hearts, the season itself is coming to an end on October 1st. So wander through the art and connect with the memorable characters throughout September, before we bid a fond farewell to this special season. 
 Days of Moonlight September 19th - October 9th Gather beneath the moon at Crescent Oasis to celebrate the Nine-Colored Deer! Assist the spirits to gain access to special event stickers and create your own murals, or view murals your friends have made during their adventures through Days of Moonlight. Once you're done, make sure to grab a mooncake with a friend and solve some of the riddles other Sky Kids have left to celebrate the event.

 Double Season Candles and Treasure Candles  September 11th - 24th Enjoy double Season Candles and double Treasure Candle bundles this month!  
 Traveling Spirits Reminder that the current group of visiting spirits will depart on September 10th September 10th - 13th September 24th - 27th Community Announcements Aviary Stage Schedule Join Tethys on the interview stage, Tuesdays and Thursdays at 4:00pm Pacific Time

news.title: Update 34.5 - August 25th, 2026
news.summary_en:
Greetings, Adventurers! Update 34.5 is launching today on Android, Huawei, iOS, PlayStation, Switch, and Steam!
For a preview of what’s coming to Sky, be sure to check out This Month in Sky! New Features & Improvements Hall of Creativity The Hall of Creativity is officially open!
news.summary_ar:
Greetings, Adventurers! Update 34.5 is launching today on Android, Huawei, iOS, PlayStation, Switch, and Steam!
For a preview of what’s coming to Sky, be sure to check out This Month in Sky! New Features & Improvements Hall of Creativity The Hall of Creativity is officially open!
news.full_en:
Greetings, Adventurers! Update 34.5 is launching today on Android, Huawei, iOS, PlayStation, Switch, and Steam!
For a preview of what’s coming to Sky, be sure to check out This Month in Sky! New Features & Improvements Hall of Creativity The Hall of Creativity is officially open! You'll find it in Aviary Village, head into the Cinema Hall and look to your right, just inside the entrance. While visiting, players can: Hang out with TGC Clementine Watch past Sky Creator Awards on two screens Socialize with other Skykids You may also notice a second room inside. More information about it will be shared in a future update. Challenges Added a new "Trivial" difficulty tier. Challenges that fall into this tier are hidden, so you'll see fewer extremely simple Challenges. Adjusted difficulty scoring so fewer Challenges are classified as "Impossible." Increased the amount of Light rewarded for easy, medium, and hard challenges.  Presence Experimental Feature Chat Across Presence When you and your friends are all actively using Presence in the same level, you can now chat with each other as if you were playing together in the same lobby. Chats from friends who are not using Presence will not be shown to you. New animations Players in Presence now have animations for: Performing a deep call Earning a Candle Purchasing an item Using the Tearful Light Miner and Admiring Actor expressions Improved Embers Embers have been visually revised to look better and to resolve some performance issues. Festival Tech also benefits from this improvement. Other improvements The Presence button in the Wing Menu no longer disappears when the feature is unavailable. Instead, it now explains why you may not be able to attune to Presence. Localization improvements Player-suggested improvements updates for French, German, Portuguese and Japanese. Fixed a number of corrupted text in different languages   Bug fixes Items in Bold are representing a fix for something players reported to us.
Please keep reporting bugs, it helps us improve the quality of the game! Audio Fixed audio crackling and distortion on lower-end Android devices. Gameplay  Fixed an issue where equipped outfits would revert to the default appearance when logging back in. Fixed an issue where Chibi would clip through terrain while in water, preventing them from interacting with dark plants at the temple in the Hidden Forest. Fixed an issue where using a STAR Pin would consume matching spells already in a player's inventory. Fixed an issue where Presence models would blink in and out. Fixed an issue where the drawing would clip fully into the ground for Chibi players when using the Draw emote. Fixed an issue where cancelling out of a transformation spell would leave the Presence button greyed out. Fixed an issue where the player who cancelled a Cradle Carry could no longer end the carry. Jumping while in Little Oreo form no longer has a slight delay. Fixed a crash affecting Android and PC players. Fixed a rendering crash affecting some lower-end Android and iOS devices. Fixed a crash that could occur when players at the friend limit received a gift. Fixed an issue where players could take photos while viewing a shared memory recorded in photo camera mode. Fixed an issue where attempting to change the name of a Skykid who has blocked you updated their appearance before the next level transition or session. Fixed an issue where a Challenge could display the wrong difficulty. Level fixes Fixed an issue where Skykids behaved erratically or became stuck inside the trees near the windmill in the Season of Dear Van Gogh level. Fixed a flickering Sunflower Painting in the Van Gogh Gallery. Localization Fixed an incorrect Season title on the questionnaire in Japanese. Fixed STAR Pin Spell descriptions for the Keychain and Tiny growth potions in Japanese. Added the missing description for the Little Oreo spell. Fixed placeholder text appearing when using the Little Oreo spell.   Outfits & Props Fixed clipping between the Season of Dear Van Gogh dress and classic capes. The Moth Plushie can now be placed on surfaces other than the floor. Seasons & Spirits Fixed an issue where a Spirit could overlap with the Season Guide in Aviary and Home. Fixed an issue where Companions following the player would appear in Season of Dear Van Gogh story levels and cutscenes. Fixed an issue where Van Gogh scratched his head through his hat during Quest 2 cutscene. In Dear Van Gogh, the date now correctly appears on the title cards for Quests 3 and 5. Fixed an issue where the Friendship indicator appeared on Spirits and Season Guides that do not use the Friendship system. Fixed an issue where a Villager spawned on top of the chess table in the Season of Two Embers level. Fixed missing facial features on the Saluting Captain Spirit. User Interface Fixed an issue where the frame rate setting did not match actual in-game performance. The Constellation can no longer be opened while in Camera mode. For Known Issues associated with this update, please see our Known Issues page . As always, we look forward to hearing your feedback, and encourage you to join the community discussion on our official Discord server at discord.gg/thatskygame !

news.full_en:
Greetings, Adventurers! We have a hotfix! 
 Changes and fixes in this update include: 
 \ Fixed an issue that caused some players to have to repeat Quest 1 before being able to move on to Quest 2 \ Certain Android devices have been experiencing a crash during Quest 3 when they are required to take a screenshot. We have implemented a workaround that allows them to skip the screenshot and continue progressing to the next quest. \ Added a special teleport functionality to the neck piece from the Starry Night's Mantle pack. This ability allows the wearer, and friends holding their hand, to teleport back to the town of Arles from Season of Van Gogh Wearer must have already visited the town via Quest 3 before the teleport ability will work The town will have a day/night cycle When visiting the town using the neck piece, players' avatars will appear as normal instead of with the spirit effect that was present during the Dear Van Gogh quests Once in town, players can activate a painting activity followed by a photo-op

 As always, we look forward to hearing your feedback, and encourage you to join the community discussion on our official Discord server at discord.gg/thatskygame !

Sky News Update 34.5 August 25th Our next regular update is on its way! Keep an eye out on our Patch Notes page, linked at the bottom of this article, for details on the 34.5 update when it goes live on August 25th. 
 Days of Sunlight July 31st - August 20th Days of Sunlight will run through August 20th, so make sure to visit the event space in Hidden Forest and enjoy some summer fun! For those who aren’t quite ready to say farewell when the event ends, the lake will stick around for a few days so Sky Kids can enjoy some extra time in the water. 
 Summer Camping Event August 28th - September 10th Between Days of Sunlight and Days of Moonlight, get cozy during our Summer Camping Event! Create and share your dream campsite, relax by the bonfire, and take some deep breaths while enjoying the beautiful scenery.   The group of spirits from Season of the Nine-Colored Deer will be visiting during this time, too! Make sure to say hi, and spend some time together before they leave on September 10th.  
 Radiance Event August 14th - 27th White and magenta Colored Light will appear more often from August 14th through 27th. Make sure to take advantage of this Radiance event if you’ve been looking for a dye refresh! 
 Traveling Spirits August 13th - 16th August 27th - 30th Group spirit visit, Nine-Colored Deer: August 28th - September 10th Make sure to say hi to them and upgrade your friendships, since they leave on September 10th and won’t be available during Days of Moonlight. Community Eden Run August 21st at 4:30pm Pacific Time Join staff members and other Sky Kids for another group trip through the storm! news.full_en:
Greetings, Adventurers! We have a hotfix! 
 Changes and fixes in this update include: \ Fixed an issue that sometimes caused a softlock when replaying Quest 3 due to the camera getting stuck in the wrong position \ Fixed some clipping issues with the paintings during Quest 3 \ Fixed a graphical corruption issue for the Starry hair that would occur in Shared Memories \ Fixed a softlock that could occur during Quest 3 if the player moved too far away during Van Gogh's monologue \ Fixed an issue in Quest 3 that caused Van Gogh's backpack and canvas to appear black \ Fixed an issue that caused brush strokes to disappear after using the return shrine to return to Quest 4 \ Fixed the friendship menu appearing empty after rekindling a friendship with another player \ Fixed an issue that caused some equipped props to remain disabled after exiting a Challenge \ Fixed an issue where Nest capacity upgrades were not registering correctly, causing decorations to disappear from some players' Nests. This fix was implemented for other platforms in update 34.1 \ Fixed a prop-related crash affecting some players after downloading 34.0. This fix was implemented for other platforms in update 34.1 We are aware of some issues still affecting players that were not able to be addressed with this patch, and are working on fixes. Please keep an eye out on our Known Issues and future update notes for more information. Thank you for your patience. As always, we look forward to hearing your feedback, and encourage you to join the community discussion on our official Discord server at discord.gg/thatskygame !

news.full_en:
Three hearts, one infinite canvas, together we illuminate a starry night.
 Dear Van Gogh is an interactive journey through the life, art, and inner world of Vincent van Gogh. Travel inside his paintings to witness his earliest uncertainties, his Paris awakening, and the fragile beauty of his final years. Discover and feel the weight of a life lived, and the invisible hands that held it together. 

From the award-winning creators of Journey, join a global community and play through an unforgettable experience of empathy, connection, and art.

 A Story Most People Have Never Heard 
Everyone knows the legend of Van Gogh. Few know the full story.

At the heart of Van Gogh’s life was a decades-long exchange of letters with his brother, Theo, filled with doubt, wonder, and unfailing devotion that made Van Gogh’s art possible in the first place. Now you can discover that bond firsthand. Guided by Johanna, Theo’s wife and the quiet force who carried Vincent’s legacy forward, you will piece together the story behind the paintings and discover that what we call genius was also, and always, an act of love.

Dear Van Gogh is their story, as much as his. 

 Art You Can Walk Through 
Explore beautiful, playable environments made from Van Gogh's best known paintings, from sunlit fields in the Netherlands to the glowing night skies that only he could imagine. Each and every landscape is a work of art in motion, rendered in his bold, expressive brushstroke style and alive with the emotion he poured into every canvas. 
 Paint the World with Others 
Just as Van Gogh was never truly alone in his creative journey, neither are you. Use Sky’s signature brushstroke mechanic to collaborate with other players, bringing color and light back to the world together. Because some things are simply more beautiful when shared.
 Return to the Real World, Evolved 
At the end of the experience, pause and look back at what you experienced. You’re welcome to reflect on and share what you observed and what moved you. Dear Van Gogh in Sky is more than just a game, it is an invitation to see one of history’s greatest artists in a new light, and question everything you thought you knew about the story behind the art.
